name: There Is Nothing Left to Lose

podcast.body: Released on November 2, 1999, this album marked Taylor Hawkins' debut as the band's drummer. It features 11 songs, all of which Taylor Hawkins is credited as a co-writer. "Taylor's first album as a food was there is nothing left to lose, which was released on November 2nd, 1999."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: The Foo Fighters' third album, released in 1999, was awarded a Grammy. Its first pressing featured unique artwork of the Foo Fighters logo tattooed on the back of Dave Grohl's neck, accompanied by a rub-on tattoo bonus. An Australian edition stood out with different black-and-white artwork depicting swimmer Michael Klim bearing a Foo Fighters tattoo, and included the extra track "Fraternity" along with a four-track video disc, making it somewhat collectible (used copies could be found from $7). A Norwegian special edition released on December 4th, 2002, further augmented the album with bonus tracks recorded live in Oslo. "Here are a few things about the third Fuz album there is nothing left to lose. If you know the album artwork there's a shot of the back of Dave's head with the Fufu foiter logo on the back of his neck. The first pressing of that 1999 album came with a rub on tattoo just like that one."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
